_comment: Secrets (postgresAdminPassword, containerImage, entraTenantId, entraClientId, acrLoginServer, portalJwtSecret, aiKeyEncryptionKey) are NOT in this file — CI passes them via --parameters overrides sourced from GitHub Secrets. See .github/workflows/deploy.yml. AI provider is per-tenant BYOK (frontend), not a deployment secret.
_sizing: B2 (2 vCPU/3.5GB) + Postgres B2s (2 vCore/4GB) + 64GiB (240 IOPS) + Azure Managed Redis Balanced_B0, sized for ~5 companies / 1000+ employees. Postgres compute scales with a ~2 min restart, so start here and move up on metrics. Keep webConcurrency <= plan vCPUs: it divides the AI concurrency limit and multiplies the DB pool (2 x (3+2) = 10 connections).
